description: Luw.ai Expand AI: outpaint a tightly cropped architectural or interior photo to a wider view. Costs 1 credit.

image.description: Photo to expand (public https:// link or data: URI; the local npx server also accepts a file path).

precision.description: How far to extend each side, as a share of the photo's size: 90+ about 10%, 61-89 about 17%, 60 or less about 25% (default).
